culprit_citations.quoted_text: AA&D Midco principal 31,368 is prefixed by $ in the Principal / Shares column; cost and fair value are likewise prefixed by $.
The immediately following AA&D Midco row has principal 2,726 in the same Principal / Shares column with the repeated currency-symbol cell blank.

findings.detail: FX01 classified blank repeated currency-symbol cells as non-USD instead of carrying forward the schedule's dollar denomination.

rationale: Raw source decides the flag: table 11 row 5 establishes dollar denomination for the schedule columns, and row 6 continues with numeric principal, cost, and fair value in those same columns while omitting only the repeated dollar glyph. The 302 missing principal_amount_usd warnings therefore arise from treating presentation blanks as evidence of non-USD currency, not from missing FX conversions in the filing data. The check is wrong for these carry-forward currency cells.
